programme.title: Nature Time
programme.desc: It’s time to get closer to nature. Loved by all ages and stages, NatureTime is a free streaming channel that features compelling wildlife and nature stories from around the world.

programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Giro del mondo in 80 persone ( Andata) Ep8 - Patrizio è ancora alle Marchesi, il giro del mondo di Adriatica prosegue in Polinesia. Esploriamo le isole Tuamotu, i luoghi di Folco Quilici, il celebre realizzatore di documentari che ha fatto sognare ad occhi aperti una generazione intera. Syusy esplora l'isola in lungo e in largo, ma soprattutto si imbatte in persone davvero interessanti. Dopo aver conosciuto i ragazzi del collegio di Avatonu, a Tiputà vive l'emozione dell'incontro con un ex attore di Quilici.

programme.title: Popoli del mare
programme.desc: La laguna di Orbetello - Nuova tappa del viaggio sulle rotte dei Popoli del Mare: da Porto Santo Stefano partiamo per un giro dell'Argentario, fino a Porto Ercole. Porto Ercole deve il suo nome agli Etruschi che eressero qui una fortezza che rispecchiava la costellazione di Ercole, eroe assoluto degli Argonauti. Siamo nella punta più estrema del promontorio, dove fu trovato spiaggiato il corpo senza vita del Caravaggio, morto di malaria. Ma l'obiettivo di Syusy è scoprire qualcosa in più dell'antico Porto di #Orbetello, praticamente inespugnabile in passato, ben protetto dai tomboli della Giannella e della Feniglia, a partire dagli studi di Mario Pincherle (vedi il libro "Il porto invisibile di Orbetello"). La misteriosa opera idraulica della Tagliata di Ansedonia e - soprattutto - le mura ciclopiche poligonali, datate ufficialmente al 200/300 a.C. Possibile che siano costruzioni romane? Lo stesso Vitruvio si espresse diversamente, attribuendole a popolazioni ben più antiche. Altrettanto arcaico il tempio sull'acropoli di Cosa, dedicato al culto della mater matuta.

programme.title: Popoli del mare
programme.desc: Tarquinia: da Enea al simposio etrusco - Questa tappa del viaggio sulle Rotte dei Popoli del Mare inizia sull'isola di Giannutri, dove facciamo rivivere il passato mettendo in scena la ricostruzione dell'arrivo di Giasone. Poi l'equipaggio di Adriatica naviga fino a Civitavecchia per raggiungere Tarquinia, uno dei siti archeologici etruschi più importanti. Qui visitiamo i resti dell'acropoli e il museo, per concludere con un vero Simposio Etrusco con i Ludi Scaenici! Più che un Simposio, un Banchetto, dato che partecipano sia uomini che donne… Lo scenario è quello delle grotte ipogee di Tarquinia, che dire, sembra di fare davvero un salto indietro fino al tempo dei Popoli del Mare!

programme.title: TG del turismo
programme.desc: Il turismo vive un momento complesso tra aumento dei costi e difficoltà nei viaggi, soprattutto aerei. Si resta quindi in Italia con eventi come il Bike Festival del Garda e il festival “Musica sulle Apuane”, tra natura e cultura. Spazio anche a consigli utili come le assicurazioni di viaggio, a contenuti dedicati come il viaggio di Syusy con la figlia e a proposte future, tra cui un itinerario in Romania sulle tracce di Dracula.

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Il viaggio parte da Trieste alla ricerca di un’ospitalità autentica, tra residenze che permettono di vivere la città come “cittadini temporanei”. L’esplorazione continua attraverso i sapori e le tradizioni locali, dalle storiche pasticcerie legate alla cultura mitteleuropea del caffè al gelato artigianale, passando per la cucina di mare e curiosità legate al vento di Bora, che influenza persino lo stile dei triestini. Il percorso si sposta poi sull’Altopiano Carsico, tra natura, agriturismi e storie di vita legate al territorio. La puntata si chiude con un’eccellenza unica: uno spumante affinato sott’acqua nel Golfo di Trieste, simbolo di un viaggio fatto di luoghi, persone e racconti.

programme.title: Slow tour padano
programme.desc: Patrizio riparte dal Piemonte con una Guzzi elettrica, cercando esempi di economia circolare. Incontra agricoltori che uniscono tradizione e innovazione: dal contadino con cavallo al caseificio smart, dai castagneti occitani agli artigiani del legno.

programme.title: Slow tour padano
programme.desc: Tra Piemonte e Lombardia scopre grani antichi, mulini artigianali, barcaioli e prati stabili. Visita caseifici che producono Grana Padano kosher e halal, esempi di multiculturalità. Approfondisce progetti scientifici per ridurre l’impatto ambientale della filiera.

programme.title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso
programme.sub-title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso S1 Ep5
programme.desc: La Tonnarella. Diportisti anfibi in provincia di Genova e alle Cinque Terre. Tra la Via dell'Amore di Riomaggiore e l'area marina protetta di Portofino a San Fruttuoso, dove imbattersi in una Tonnarella (pratica di pesca tradizionale a impatto zero sull'ecosistema) o immergersi a 15 metri di profondità per vedere il Cristo degli Abissi: una statua di bronzo adagiata sul fondo del mare, star dei sub che vengono apposta per nuotare fino al suo basamento. Poi un itinerario nella Genova del liberty e nel borgo marinaro di Boccadasse, terra di cantautori, scrittori e poeti.

programme.title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso
programme.sub-title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Velisti molto per caso. Una puntata interamente dedicata al sud della Sardegna in barca a vela: Syusy e Patrizio navigano tra Cagliari, Nora e Sant'Antioco

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Liguria di Levante e Ponente In questa tappa di Italia Slow Tour, il viaggio inizia nel Ponente Ligure, dove la bellezza si rivela "goccia a goccia" tra le atmosfere sospese di San Bartolomeo al Mare e l'eleganza storica di Diano Marina. Qui, l’accoglienza spazia dal respiro nobile di Villa San Giuseppe al fascino "anni d'oro" dell'Hotel Moresco, fino al cuore rurale dell’Agriturismo Le Raganelle, dove incontriamo l'ospitalità autentica di Edoardo. Il percorso prosegue verso Imperia, alla scoperta dei sapori ancestrali de La Sciamadda, il tempio della farinata e dello street food dei portuali, per poi risalire verso l'incanto di Cervo, borgo della musica classica, dove il mare si assapora a picco sugli scogli. Oltrepassata Genova, il viaggio tocca Nervi e i suoi echi ottocenteschi a Villa Bonera, per poi approdare nel Levante. Tra le sete preziose di Zoagli e la schiettezza culinaria della Trattoria La Bettola, arriviamo infine a Chiavari. In un intreccio tra passato e presente, esploriamo la città dei portici medievali: dalla dolcezza storica dell'Antica Gelateria Verdi all'innovazione della Pinseria Ca de Pria, fino a rendere omaggio al maestoso Teatro Cantero, gigante addormentato e simbolo della grandezza culturale ligure. Un mosaico di volti, sapori e architetture che dimostra come la Liguria non sia solo una stretta striscia di terra, ma un distillato di storie tenute insieme dal profumo della salsedine.

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Liguria Golfo del Tigullio In questo nuova puntata di Italia Slow Tour, torniamo in Liguria guidati alla scoperta della nobiltà marinara di questa regione tra il Golfo Paradiso e il Tigullio. Il viaggio celebra una terra dove i colori delle case non sono solo estetica, ma storici segnali per i marinai in mare, e dove ogni borgo racconta una storia di pesca, letteratura e ospitalità d'eccellenza. Il tour si snoda attraverso località iconiche, alternando la vivacità dei porticcioli alla tranquillità delle colline. Definita la "Città dei mille bianchi velieri", viene esplorata attraverso la sua cucina di pesce fresco Egidio, La Rotonda, Mille e Una Notte e l'anima aristocratica dell'Hotel Cenobio dei Dogi, antica dimora dei nobili genovesi. Sestri Levante: La "città dei due mari" la Baia del Silenzio e la Baia delle Favole dove la modernità culinaria de Il Besugo e del Pelagica incontra la tradizione autentica della trattoria Ca du Luasso. Oltre il Mare: Il racconto si sposta verso l'entroterra verde con l'Hotel Villa Agnese, focalizzato sulla sostenibilità, e la vista panoramica del B&B La Collina sul Mare. Santa Margherita e Rapallo: Il viaggio si conclude tra l'eleganza mondana del ristorante Il Patio a "Santa" e la ricchezza storica di Rapallo, città amata da Hemingway, soggiornando all'intimo Hotel San Desiderio. "Non serve un piano perfetto per trovare la perfezione. Basta seguire la linea della costa, ascoltare il rumore della risacca e sedersi a tavola dove ci porta il cuore." In Liguria, il tour dimostra che ogni piatto e ogni pietra hanno una voce per chi sa fermarsi ad ascoltare, trasformando un viaggio casuale in un'esperienza di profonda connessione con il territorio

programme.title: TG del turismo
programme.desc: Viaggiare, soprattutto in aereo, è sempre più complesso tra cancellazioni, rincari e incertezze legate alle crisi globali. Si propongono quindi alternative in Italia, come la Giornata delle Dimore Storiche con visite gratuite e le gite in treno verso mete culturali come Villa Bernasconi. Spazio anche a progetti artistici come il viaggio di Adriatica, esperienze immersive come il Titanic in realtà virtuale e nuove collaborazioni editoriali e promozioni dedicate ai viaggiatori.

programme.title: Syusy Blady ai confini della realtà
programme.sub-title: Syusy Blady ai confini della realtà S2 Ep1 - con Victor Nunzi
programme.desc: Vi siete mai chiesti che rapporti avevano fra di loro gli Dei Sumeri? I loro intrecci amorosi? Le loro battaglie per il potere? Con Victor Nunzi, autore del libro "La regalità degli dèi", parliamo del carattere e degli eventi che hanno caratterizzato ognuna delle divinità Anunnaki. Un vero e proprio gossip che ci viene dal passato...

programme.title: I Mondi di Syusy
programme.sub-title: I Mondi di Syusy - Attraversando il bardo
programme.desc: Attraversando il bardo: a Kathmandu - Syusy Blady ha seguito Franco Battiato a Kathmandu in Nepal per raccontare il backstage del suo documentario "Attraversando il Bardo". Un approfondimento che esplora il passaggio tra la vita e la morte, un tema che i monaci tibetani conoscono bene. Intervistando Lama Monlam e Lama Rinpoche, hanno approfondito questo mistero. Syusy e Battiato avevano già viaggiato insieme in Nepal ai tempi di Turisti per Caso

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: In questa puntata di Italia Slow Tour Ambassador si scopre una Firenze autentica, oltre i monumenti, attraverso incontri con artigiani, botteghe storiche e custodi delle tradizioni. Tra sapori tipici, accoglienza e luoghi simbolo, emerge l’anima della città fatta di gesti quotidiani e saper fare. Un invito a rallentare e a riscoprire Firenze attraverso le persone, veri ambasciatori del suo spirito.

programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Giro del mondo in 80 persone ( Andata) Ep7 - Mentre Syusy è in Ecuador, Patrizio e David Riondino arrivano in Polinesia sull'isola di Fatu Hiva. Approdato a Hiva Oa Pat si cimenta anche con lo sport nazionale della Polinesia, la piroga. Ad Atouna si imbuca ad una festa molto invitante, e coglie l'occasione per improvvisare un'intervista al commissario dei Territori Francesi d'Oltremare. Pat e David vengono poi raggiunti dal famoso artista Marcello Jori.

programme.title: Slow tour - Campania divina
programme.desc: Uno Slow Tour di Syusy Blady tra Caserta, Napoli e Salerno seguendo il filo conduttore del divino femminile. Syusy Blady e sua figlia Zoe intraprendono un viaggio in Campania, esplorando luoghi intrisi di storia e misticismo. Si avventurano nei Campi Flegrei, la "porta dell'inferno" dantesca, scoprendo il vulcano e l'antichissimo, quasi tecnologico, antro della Sibilla Cumana. A Capua, visitano l'anfiteatro che rivaleggia con il Colosseo e il Museo delle Mater Matuta, dove statue votive di fertilità raccontano un ideale di bellezza arcaico. Infine, madre e figlia ammirano la maestosa Reggia di Caserta, con la sua fontana a cuore per la Regina Margherita, e si immergono nei miti femminili di Napoli, dalla sirena Partenope che diede origine al Golfo, a Villa Floridiana, dono d'amore regale.

programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Giro del mondo in 80 persone ( Andata) Ep8 - Patrizio è ancora alle Marchesi, il giro del mondo di Adriatica prosegue in Polinesia. L’esplorazione continua attraverso i sapori e le tradizioni locali, dalle storiche pasticcerie legate alla cultura mitteleuropea del caffè al gelato artigianale, passando per la cucina di mare e curiosità legate al vento di Bora, che influenza persino lo stile dei triestini. Il percorso si sposta poi sull’Altopiano Carsico, tra natura, agriturismi e storie di vita legate al territorio. La puntata si chiude con un’eccellenza unica: uno spumante affinato sott’acqua nel Golfo di Trieste, simbolo di un viaggio fatto di luoghi, persone e racconti.

programme.title: Slow tour padano
programme.desc: Patrizio riparte dal Piemonte con una Guzzi elettrica, cercando esempi di economia circolare. Incontra agricoltori che uniscono tradizione e innovazione: dal contadino con cavallo al caseificio smart, dai castagneti occitani agli artigiani del legno.

programme.title: Slow tour padano
programme.desc: Tra Piemonte e Lombardia scopre grani antichi, mulini artigianali, barcaioli e prati stabili. Visita caseifici che producono Grana Padano kosher e halal, esempi di multiculturalità. Approfondisce progetti scientifici per ridurre l’impatto ambientale della filiera.

programme.sub-title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso S1 Ep5
programme.desc: La Tonnarella. Diportisti anfibi in provincia di Genova e alle Cinque Terre. Tra la Via dell'Amore di Riomaggiore e l'area marina protetta di Portofino a San Fruttuoso, dove imbattersi in una Tonnarella (pratica di pesca tradizionale a impatto zero sull'ecosistema) o immergersi a 15 metri di profondità per vedere il Cristo degli Abissi: una statua di bronzo adagiata sul fondo del mare, star dei sub che vengono apposta per nuotare fino al suo basamento. Poi un itinerario nella Genova del liberty e nel borgo marinaro di Boccadasse, terra di cantautori, scrittori e poeti.

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Liguria di Levante e Ponente In questa tappa di Italia Slow Tour, il viaggio inizia nel Ponente Ligure, dove la bellezza si rivela "goccia a goccia" tra le atmosfere sospese di San Bartolomeo al Mare e l'eleganza storica di Diano Marina. Qui, l’accoglienza spazia dal respiro nobile di Villa San Giuseppe al fascino "anni d'oro" dell'Hotel Moresco, fino al cuore rurale dell’Agriturismo Le Raganelle, dove incontriamo l'ospitalità autentica di Edoardo. Il percorso prosegue verso Imperia, alla scoperta dei sapori ancestrali de La Sciamadda, il tempio della farinata e dello street food dei portuali, per poi risalire verso l'incanto di Cervo, borgo della musica classica, dove il mare si assapora a picco sugli scogli. Oltrepassata Genova, il viaggio tocca Nervi e i suoi echi ottocenteschi a Villa Bonera, per poi approdare nel Levante. Tra le sete preziose di Zoagli e la schiettezza culinaria della Trattoria La Bettola, arriviamo infine a Chiavari. In un intreccio tra passato e presente, esploriamo la città dei portici medievali: dalla dolcezza storica dell'Antica Gelateria Verdi all'innovazione della Pinseria Ca de Pria, fino a rendere omaggio al maestoso Teatro Cantero, gigante addormentato e simbolo della grandezza culturale ligure. Un mosaico di volti, sapori e architetture che dimostra come la Liguria non sia solo una stretta striscia di terra, ma un distillato di storie tenute insieme dal profumo della salsedine.

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Liguria Golfo del Tigullio In questo nuova puntata di Italia Slow Tour, torniamo in Liguria guidati alla scoperta della nobiltà marinara di questa regione tra il Golfo Paradiso e il Tigullio. Il viaggio celebra una terra dove i colori delle case non sono solo estetica, ma storici segnali per i marinai in mare, e dove ogni borgo racconta una storia di pesca, letteratura e ospitalità d'eccellenza. Il tour si snoda attraverso località iconiche, alternando la vivacità dei porticcioli alla tranquillità delle colline. Definita la "Città dei mille bianchi velieri", viene esplorata attraverso la sua cucina di pesce fresco Egidio, La Rotonda, Mille e Una Notte e l'anima aristocratica dell'Hotel Cenobio dei Dogi, antica dimora dei nobili genovesi. Sestri Levante: La "città dei due mari" la Baia del Silenzio e la Baia delle Favole dove la modernità culinaria de Il Besugo e del Pelagica incontra la tradizione autentica della trattoria Ca du Luasso. Oltre il Mare: Il racconto si sposta verso l'entroterra verde con l'Hotel Villa Agnese, focalizzato sulla sostenibilità, e la vista panoramica del B&B La Collina sul Mare. Santa Margherita e Rapallo: Il viaggio si conclude tra l'eleganza mondana del ristorante Il Patio a "Santa" e la ricchezza storica di Rapallo, città amata da Hemingway, soggiornando all'intimo Hotel San Desiderio. "Non serve un piano perfetto per trovare la perfezione. Basta seguire la linea della costa, ascoltare il rumore della risacca e sedersi a tavola dove ci porta il cuore." In Liguria, il tour dimostra che ogni piatto e ogni pietra hanno una voce per chi sa fermarsi ad ascoltare, trasformando un viaggio casuale in un'esperienza di profonda connessione con il territorio

programme.title: TG del turismo
programme.desc: Viaggiare, soprattutto in aereo, è sempre più complesso tra cancellazioni, rincari e incertezze legate alle crisi globali. Si propongono quindi alternative in Italia, come la Giornata delle Dimore Storiche con visite gratuite e le gite in treno verso mete culturali come Villa Bernasconi. Spazio anche a progetti artistici come il viaggio di Adriatica, esperienze immersive come il Titanic in realtà virtuale e nuove collaborazioni editoriali e promozioni dedicate ai viaggiatori.

programme.sub-title: Syusy Blady ai confini della realtà S2 Ep1 - con Victor Nunzi
programme.desc: Vi siete mai chiesti che rapporti avevano fra di loro gli Dei Sumeri? I loro intrecci amorosi? Le loro battaglie per il potere? Un vero e proprio gossip che ci viene dal passato...

Tra sapori tipici, accoglienza e luoghi simbolo, emerge l’anima della città fatta di gesti quotidiani e saper fare. Un invito a rallentare e a riscoprire Firenze attraverso le persone, veri ambasciatori del suo spirito.

programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Giro del mondo in 80 persone ( Andata) Ep7 - Mentre Syusy è in Ecuador, Patrizio e David Riondino arrivano in Polinesia sull'isola di Fatu Hiva. Approdato a Hiva Oa Pat si cimenta anche con lo sport nazionale della Polinesia, la piroga. Ad Atouna si imbuca ad una festa molto invitante, e coglie l'occasione per improvvisare un'intervista al commissario dei Territori Francesi d'Oltremare. Pat e David vengono poi raggiunti dal famoso artista Marcello Jori.

programme.title: Slow tour - Campania divina
programme.desc: Uno Slow Tour di Syusy Blady tra Caserta, Napoli e Salerno seguendo il filo conduttore del divino femminile. Syusy Blady e sua figlia Zoe intraprendono un viaggio in Campania, esplorando luoghi intrisi di storia e misticismo. Si avventurano nei Campi Flegrei, la "porta dell'inferno" dantesca, scoprendo il vulcano e l'antichissimo, quasi tecnologico, antro della Sibilla Cumana. A Capua, visitano l'anfiteatro che rivaleggia con il Colosseo e il Museo delle Mater Matuta, dove statue votive di fertilità raccontano un ideale di bellezza arcaico. Infine, madre e figlia ammirano la maestosa Reggia di Caserta, con la sua fontana a cuore per la Regina Margherita, e si immergono nei miti femminili di Napoli, dalla sirena Partenope che diede origine al Golfo, a Villa Floridiana, dono d'amore regale.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When three unsuspecting investors are bilked by racketeer, Harley Dexter, the Angels scheme to con Dexter into returning the money. Kelly persuades Dexter to use laundered syndicate money to buy her truckload of Mayan artifacts; Kris works an ingenious switch of her worthless Rolls Royce for Dexter's Rolls and Tiffany poses as a Senator's aide demanding payment to stop the Senator's investigation of Dexter's syndicate ties. Dexter is ruined when the syndicate realizes that the Maya artifacts are phony. Kris Rolls Royce is junked and the Senator arranges a Grand Jury injunction against Dexter. The original investors receive their money and Dexter is last seen being cornered by his syndicate ties demanding their money.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: After a number of attempts on the Angels' lives, Charlie hires Antonia Blake to protect them. Toni's boys (Bob, Matt and Cotton) are expert detectives but the Angels resist their orders to stay undercover and not venture out of Toni's mansion. Racketeer Danny Flores is tipped off to the presence of an investigation in which Tiffany figures prominently. They are sleuthing his modeling agency so he captures her in hopes of drawing the other Angels around. The guys uncover Flores' winery, a front for a scheme to infiltrate an elite gathering but Flores recognizes Kris and Kelly as hostesses at this affair for the rich, and in an effort to save them, Toni's boys are forced to blow their cover. Flores' men overcome the guys and then proceed with their original plan to seal the Angels behind a brick wall where they will suffocate. Toni's boys storm the hacienda and wine cellar.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Part 1 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his "Margaret" ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. Kelly is suddenly heir to the massive Barrows fortune, including the stately Barrows Hotel, which was scheduled to be donated to the city if no heir were found.

programme.desc: Aspiring entrepreneurs pitch their business ideas to moguls, known as the "Sharks," in hopes of landing investment funds in this U.S. adaptation of the British and Japanese reality hit Dragons' Den.

programme.title: First Sunday
programme.desc: Two best friends/petty thieves plan to rob their local church, but end-up befriending the choir group and restoring their faith.

programme.title: The Oath (2018)
programme.desc: THE OATH centers around a man (Ike Barinholtz) and his wife (Tiffany Haddish) whose Thanksgiving takes a turn when two federal agents -- being held captive in their living room -- give the extended family something to worry about beyond their typical Holiday dinner table political rift.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians puts together a purposely horrible team so they'll lose and she can move the team. But when the plot is uncovered, they start winning just to spite her.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Nice Dreams
programme.desc: Comedy team Cheech & Chong star as ice cream vendors in this thoroughly wacky comedy. This outrageous, permanently spaced-out duo sell enough of their "specially mixed" ice cream to take the cash and realize their fondest dreams: new guitars, islands in the sun and beautiful women.

programme.title: Troop Beverly Hills (1989)
programme.desc: Shelley Long stars as a spoiled Beverly Hills resident who does nothing but shop, prompting her husband to tell her he's fed up with her selfishness.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Philadelphia hopes the Sharks don't take a bite out of him while pitching a smart plate containing food-recognition technology that could solve all your dieting problems; two energetic women from Minneapolis, MN and Waco, TX have created a sweetener that tastes just like honey, but not made by bees. The Sharks crack up at the sight of a Houston, TX-based entrepreneur's unique spa business for babies; and a perhaps too-confident Stanford grad from San Francisco, CA believes he's at the forefront of where high tech meets fashion for men's custom shirts. In a follow-up on Ilumi, the company in which Mark Cuban invested in during Season 5, we see how their wirelessly controlled LED lights have illuminated the business world.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A former business analyst from West Hollywood, California, aims to bring back the nostalgic joy of sleep-away camp to adults; two business partners from Smithtown, New York, and Wilmington, North Carolina, pitch a product that will protect your car from extreme weather conditions; a 15-year-old entrepreneur from Boca Raton, Florida, hopes to win over the Sharks with her redesigned lacrosse equipment; and a man from Fairfield, Ohio, presents a revamped video game version of the classic pinball machine for the home. Also, an update from Samantha Meis and Connor Riley and their coffee subscription "experience," Misto Box, in which Mark Cuban invested in during season four.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Three friends from Oakland, CA try to sell the sharks on a breath freshener that has dual uses; a woman from Parker, CO seeks a huge valuation for a functional kid’s placemat; and a 23-year-old Baltimore man wants to fight hunger and help the environment with his “ugly” produce subscription service -- will the sharks find it attractive? Plus, a follow up on the Houston-based founders of LuminAid, inflatable, solar-powered lights in which Mark Cuban invested during Season Six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A college student from Las Vegas, NV who earned a perfect SAT score wants to expand his business to help others increase their test scores, but can he deliver a perfect pitch to the Sharks? Husband and wife exercise enthusiasts from Jenison, MI believe they have created the ideal sports bra that women have long been looking for; two millennials from Denver, CO want to sell the sharks on a high-tech backpack company but plan on keeping their lucrative other backpack company for themselves; and a serial entrepreneur and his two business partners from Bixby, OK have invested a staggering amount on a cooling appliance for outdoor use. Also, an update on Pat Crowley from Salt Lake City, UT and his energy bars fortified with protein from crickets, Chapul Cricket Bars, in which Mark Cuban invested in during Season 5.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A 16-year-old environmentalist from Melbourne, FL has an eco-friendly way to say goodbye to plastic bottles; a former soap star villainess from Sherman Oaks, CA wants the sharks to make a deal with her one-piece swimsuit that can keep you sun-safe and stylish; two men from Washington, DC pitch an app that creates exercise play lists for the everyday person; and a man from Corinth, TX promises to expose the hidden, dirty secrets lurking in your mattress. Plus, a follow up on Chris Gilpin from Sanford, FL and Signal Vault, his business that protects consumers from crowd-hack-attacks, in which Lori Greiner and Robert Herjavec invested in.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two high school freshmen from Denver, Colorado, pitch a tasty way to improve the ice cream cone; an entrepreneur from Bend, Oregon, presents a reinvented kid stroller with an athletic twist; a woman from Austin, Texas, hopes to make the lives of parents easier with her line of child products; and a magician duo from Las Vegas, Nevada, performs a music-magic entertainment spectacle, but will the Sharks see through the illusion? Also, an update on Kurt and Shawnna Feddersen from Sapulpa, Oklahoma and Gameday Couture, their fashionable women’s gameday apparel, which Mark Cuban invested in during season six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A developer from San Francisco, California, incites a battle between two of the billionaire Sharks, as they fight to invest in his early education software platform. A fashion blogger from Los Angeles, California, hopes to win over the Sharks with her fashion networking mobile app; a pair of entrepreneurs from New York introduces a convenient way for people to access umbrellas on a rainy day; and two business partners from Altadena, California, have designed a way for kids to enjoy eating healthier. Also, an update on Ryan Fant and Nayeem Hussain from New York and Keen Home, their line of home enhancement products that Robert Herjavec invested in during season six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A beer enthusiast duo from Pittsburgh, PA presents a new way of keeping beer chilled for a longer amount of time; an entrepreneur and a former aerospace engineer from New York City aim to reinvent the vending machine; two animal lovers from Austin, TX pitch safer, natural and organic bug repellents for pets; and a woman also from Austin, TX hopes to make clean eating more convenient with her line of vegetable smoothies, but will her product agree with the Sharks' taste buds? Also, an update on Wombi Rose and John Wise from Boston, MA and LovePop, their line of intricate, 3D pop-up greeting cards that Kevin O'Leary invested in during Season Seven.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A woman from Boston, Massachusetts, hopes the Sharks will make a deal and sink their teeth into her chocolate treats that are perfect for women who want to satisfy cravings; a season four entrepreneur from Aeworth, Georgia, returns for a second chance to pitch the Sharks his new business, a line of men’s hair products; a man from Telluride, Colorado, who is desperate for capital, plans to warm the Sharks' hearts with an app that allows users to electronically send handwritten cards; and a man from Boston, Massachusetts, believes he has created a unique way to break bad habits with self-zapping wristbands. Also, recaps and updates featuring the various entrepreneurs that appeared during season seven.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two men from Provo, UT put going to the bathroom at night in a whole new light when their motion-activated LED light is attached to the toilet bowl; two Madison, WI guys use 21st century technology and the power of crowd sourcing to create an alternative to traditional beer; a self-proclaimed introvert from Orem, UT wants to combat blah-looking clothes with vibrant fashions full of unusual flair; and two animal lovers from Cedarpines Park, CA are willing to paw, scratch and pet their way into a deal with their interactive and innovative pet toys. Also, an update on Ryan "Cowboy" Ehmann from Mead, CO and his Lose 12 Inches workout program that teaches people how to exercise in their heart rate zone, in which Daymond John invested in during Season Four.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two former advertising guys in New York try to sell the Sharks a cure for cell-phone addiction; emotions rise when entrepreneurs from Orlando, Florida talk about the inspiration behind their wireless cuddly toy that tells science and math stories to children; two pet lovers from Austin, Texas design and customize accessories for the most important member of the family: your one-of-a-kind pet; and two men from Huntington Beach, California hope they can lock up an investment deal with their high-tech "smart" tool box. Also, Lori Greiner takes 10 of her entrepreneurs – whose combined sales now total $188 million - to the Orgill Trade Show in Orlando, Florida, on "Shark Tank."

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An immigrant entrepreneur from Honolulu, Hawaii, cuts her own hair in front of the Sharks to demonstrate her products; an award-winning, self-taught baker from Rochester, New York, hopes to sweeten the deal with her healthy ready-to-eat frosting; a kid-preneur sister and brother duo from Jacksonville, Florida, pitch their lucrative interchangeable jewelry business; and three business partners from San Diego, California, are determined to convince the Sharks to hop on board with their wheelless skateboards. Also, an update on Dan Barnes and Wesley Laporte from Orem, Utah, and Phone Soap, their product offering a quick and convenient way to clean your phone that Lori Greiner invested in during season six.

programme.desc: Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver Antonio Brown stops by the Tank to tout the benefits of personalized shoe slides developed by an entrepreneur from Norwood, Massachusetts; a wise-beyond-her-years 16-year-old high school junior from Naperville, Illinois, impresses the Sharks with an app that can stop cyberbullying messages before the damage can be done; two men from Howell, New Jersey, designed an ingenious at-home beer dispenser that uses sound waves that makes bottled and canned beer taste just like draft; with inspiration from her terminally ill mother, a woman from West Valley City, Utah, realized that sending heartwarming chicken soup was the perfect gift and a needed business. programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: White Sands
programme.desc: A small southwestern town Sheriff finds a body in the desert with a suitcase and five hundred thousand dollars. He impersonates the man and stumbles into an F.B.I. investigation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the horrific story of a 1957 Plymouth that is bought by a misfit student (Keith Gordon) and refurbished, and takes on human characteristics. Christine, as the Plymouth is called, exacts revenge on everyone who treated her owner badly at school and then gets even more possessive and goes after Gordon's girlfriend.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Four drifters arrive in a small frontier town and become unlikely heroes in a battle against a powerful family and a corrupt sheriff.

programme.title: Bite The Bullet
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Candice Bergen head an all-star cast that battle the trials of the rugged West in a grueling, 700-mile horse race.

programme.title: 3000 Miles To Graceland
programme.desc: Posing as Elvis impersonators, ex-convicts rob a Las Vegas casino during an Elvis Presley fan convention, but greed and dissention among them ultimately lead to betrayal and chaos.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: Eight Millimeter
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage is a private detective hired to investigate the source of a crudely shot eight millimeter film. The investigation sends him down a gritty and frightening path into society's darkest corners.

programme.title: Sniper (1993)
programme.desc: Tom Berenger is a bush-savvy Marine who teams with a political marksman (Billy Zane) to eliminate a Colombian drug lord in the jungles of Central America.

programme.title: Hollow Man 2
programme.desc: Christian Slater stars in the action-packed sequel to the box office hit Hollow Man as a dangerous invisible solider gone rouge. Facing his demise unless given a life saving serum, he hunts down the biologist involved in his transformation, the detective assigned to protect her, and the government forces that created him.

programme.title: 8 Million Ways To Die
programme.desc: Trying to help a Los Angeles prostitute, an alcholoic ex-cop runs up against her vicious Colombian drug dealer boyfriend.

programme.title: The Survivors
programme.desc: Two unemployed men find themselves the target of an out-of-work hitman, whom they disarm in a robbery attempt.

programme.title: Hero (1992)
programme.desc: When her plane crashes into a Chicago bridge, ace reporter Gale Gayley (Geena Davis) is saved by a mysterious hero. Joining Davis in this heart-warming Capra-esque comedy are Dustin Hoffman as the unlikely hero, and Andy Garcia as the homeless vet who impersonates him.

programme.title: Just One Of The Guys
programme.desc: Aspiring entrepreneurs pitch their business ideas to moguls, known as the "Sharks," in hopes of landing investment funds in this U.S. adaptation of the British and Japanese reality hit Dragons' Den.

programme.title: First Sunday
programme.desc: Two best friends/petty thieves plan to rob their local church, but end-up befriending the choir group and restoring their faith.

programme.title: The Oath (2018)
programme.desc: THE OATH centers around a man (Ike Barinholtz) and his wife (Tiffany Haddish) whose Thanksgiving takes a turn when two federal agents -- being held captive in their living room -- give the extended family something to worry about beyond their typical Holiday dinner table political rift.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians puts together a purposely horrible team so they'll lose and she can move the team. But when the plot is uncovered, they start winning just to spite her.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Major League: Back To The Minors
programme.desc: A pitcher is about to be put out to pasture when he is given the opportunity to manage a team.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Nice Dreams
programme.desc: Comedy team Cheech & Chong star as ice cream vendors in this thoroughly wacky comedy. This outrageous, permanently spaced-out duo sell enough of their "specially mixed" ice cream to take the cash and realize their fondest dreams: new guitars, islands in the sun and beautiful women.

programme.title: Troop Beverly Hills (1989)
programme.desc: Shelley Long stars as a spoiled Beverly Hills resident who does nothing but shop, prompting her husband to tell her he's fed up with her selfishness.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Jane brings in an age discrimination case only to have Parker hand it over to Kim. Grayson takes on a real estate case where his clients claim their house is haunted and gets closer to Vanessa. Fred decides to help Stacy with her money woes by hiring her to serve divorce papers. Features guest stars Jaime Ray Newman, Brooke D’Orsay, Jasmine Guy, Lauren Stamile.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Jane waits by Grayson's hospital bed for him to wake up from his coma; Parker assigns Jane a case representing a big movie star and Hollywood bad boy charged with a hit and run of a 13-year-old girl, and Kim takes a case representing a recently divorced former client suing her ex for a post-divorce booty call.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Jane finds herself with two clients when she discovers both are married to the same man. Worse yet, she has trouble distinguishing her personal life from her life in the courtroom when she discovers Tony is representing the Casanova. Kim takes on a custody case involving a baby adoption just as she finds herself with her own baby issues. Stacy decides to take destiny in her own hands when she invents the next must-have item - the "Armvelope." Features guest stars: Vivica A. Fox, Bellamy Young, David Sutcliffe, David Denman

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Just as Jane and Tony finally move their relationship to the next level, Tony receives some news that affects both their futures. When Teri's cousin faces deportation charges, Jane steps in to help with the case. Parker and Kim get closer outside of the law offices, while Grayson decides to sell the house he shared with Deb.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: When Jane’s mother is unexpectedly arrested, Jane must represent her in court before Judge Summers (Rosie O’Donnell) and reconnect with the father she has never known in order to help her mom. Meanwhile, things between Parker and Kim heat up, and Grayson gets heavily invested in a case involving a Ponzi scheme. Teri attempts to help Fred with driving and dating. Features guest stars Rosie O’Donnell, Faith Prince and Kurt Fuller

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When three unsuspecting investors are bilked by racketeer, Harley Dexter, the Angels scheme to con Dexter into returning the money. Kelly persuades Dexter to use laundered syndicate money to buy her truckload of Mayan artifacts; Kris works an ingenious switch of her worthless Rolls Royce for Dexter's Rolls and Tiffany poses as a Senator's aide demanding payment to stop the Senator's investigation of Dexter's syndicate ties. Dexter is ruined when the syndicate realizes that the Maya artifacts are phony. Kris Rolls Royce is junked and the Senator arranges a Grand Jury injunction against Dexter. The original investors receive their money and Dexter is last seen being cornered by his syndicate ties demanding their money.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: After a number of attempts on the Angels' lives, Charlie hires Antonia Blake to protect them. Toni's boys (Bob, Matt and Cotton) are expert detectives but the Angels resist their orders to stay undercover and not venture out of Toni's mansion. Racketeer Danny Flores is tipped off to the presence of an investigation in which Tiffany figures prominently. They are sleuthing his modeling agency so he captures her in hopes of drawing the other Angels around. The guys uncover Flores' winery, a front for a scheme to infiltrate an elite gathering but Flores recognizes Kris and Kelly as hostesses at this affair for the rich, and in an effort to save them, Toni's boys are forced to blow their cover. Flores' men overcome the guys and then proceed with their original plan to seal the Angels behind a brick wall where they will suffocate. Toni's boys storm the hacienda and wine cellar.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Part 1 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his "Margaret" ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. Kelly is suddenly heir to the massive Barrows fortune, including the stately Barrows Hotel, which was scheduled to be donated to the city if no heir were found.

programme.desc: Part 2 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his "Margaret" ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. programme.desc: Part 1 - Kelly and Kris pose as models and secure jobs with the Woodman Agency after the disappearance and subsequent death of model Jody Mills. They are joined by Julie Rogers, who, they later find out, is an undercover police officer working with partner Harry.

programme.desc: After the Angels check into their hotel in Hawaii, Kris is kidnapped by a man who holds her responsible for his wife's suicide.

programme.desc: Kris joins mysterious Bianca Blake in diving to look for wrecked ships. They find "The Starshine," a ship that sunk with a load of marijuana aboard -- but fail to notice that they are being observed by Claude and Walrus.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Philadelphia hopes the Sharks don't take a bite out of him while pitching a smart plate containing food-recognition technology that could solve all your dieting problems; two energetic women from Minneapolis, MN and Waco, TX have created a sweetener that tastes just like honey, but not made by bees. The Sharks crack up at the sight of a Houston, TX-based entrepreneur's unique spa business for babies; and a perhaps too-confident Stanford grad from San Francisco, CA believes he's at the forefront of where high tech meets fashion for men's custom shirts. In a follow-up on Ilumi, the company in which Mark Cuban invested in during Season 5, we see how their wirelessly controlled LED lights have illuminated the business world.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A former business analyst from West Hollywood, California, aims to bring back the nostalgic joy of sleep-away camp to adults; two business partners from Smithtown, New York, and Wilmington, North Carolina, pitch a product that will protect your car from extreme weather conditions; a 15-year-old entrepreneur from Boca Raton, Florida, hopes to win over the Sharks with her redesigned lacrosse equipment; and a man from Fairfield, Ohio, presents a revamped video game version of the classic pinball machine for the home. Also, an update from Samantha Meis and Connor Riley and their coffee subscription "experience," Misto Box, in which Mark Cuban invested in during season four.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Three friends from Oakland, CA try to sell the sharks on a breath freshener that has dual uses; a woman from Parker, CO seeks a huge valuation for a functional kid’s placemat; and a 23-year-old Baltimore man wants to fight hunger and help the environment with his “ugly” produce subscription service -- will the sharks find it attractive? Plus, a follow up on the Houston-based founders of LuminAid, inflatable, solar-powered lights in which Mark Cuban invested during Season Six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A college student from Las Vegas, NV who earned a perfect SAT score wants to expand his business to help others increase their test scores, but can he deliver a perfect pitch to the Sharks? Husband and wife exercise enthusiasts from Jenison, MI believe they have created the ideal sports bra that women have long been looking for; two millennials from Denver, CO want to sell the sharks on a high-tech backpack company but plan on keeping their lucrative other backpack company for themselves; and a serial entrepreneur and his two business partners from Bixby, OK have invested a staggering amount on a cooling appliance for outdoor use. Also, an update on Pat Crowley from Salt Lake City, UT and his energy bars fortified with protein from crickets, Chapul Cricket Bars, in which Mark Cuban invested in during Season 5.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A 16-year-old environmentalist from Melbourne, FL has an eco-friendly way to say goodbye to plastic bottles; a former soap star villainess from Sherman Oaks, CA wants the sharks to make a deal with her one-piece swimsuit that can keep you sun-safe and stylish; two men from Washington, DC pitch an app that creates exercise play lists for the everyday person; and a man from Corinth, TX promises to expose the hidden, dirty secrets lurking in your mattress. Plus, a follow up on Chris Gilpin from Sanford, FL and Signal Vault, his business that protects consumers from crowd-hack-attacks, in which Lori Greiner and Robert Herjavec invested in.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two high school freshmen from Denver, Colorado, pitch a tasty way to improve the ice cream cone; an entrepreneur from Bend, Oregon, presents a reinvented kid stroller with an athletic twist; a woman from Austin, Texas, hopes to make the lives of parents easier with her line of child products; and a magician duo from Las Vegas, Nevada, performs a music-magic entertainment spectacle, but will the Sharks see through the illusion? Also, an update on Kurt and Shawnna Feddersen from Sapulpa, Oklahoma and Gameday Couture, their fashionable women’s gameday apparel, which Mark Cuban invested in during season six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A developer from San Francisco, California, incites a battle between two of the billionaire Sharks, as they fight to invest in his early education software platform. A fashion blogger from Los Angeles, California, hopes to win over the Sharks with her fashion networking mobile app; a pair of entrepreneurs from New York introduces a convenient way for people to access umbrellas on a rainy day; and two business partners from Altadena, California, have designed a way for kids to enjoy eating healthier. Also, an update on Ryan Fant and Nayeem Hussain from New York and Keen Home, their line of home enhancement products that Robert Herjavec invested in during season six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A beer enthusiast duo from Pittsburgh, PA presents a new way of keeping beer chilled for a longer amount of time; an entrepreneur and a former aerospace engineer from New York City aim to reinvent the vending machine; two animal lovers from Austin, TX pitch safer, natural and organic bug repellents for pets; and a woman also from Austin, TX hopes to make clean eating more convenient with her line of vegetable smoothies, but will her product agree with the Sharks' taste buds? Also, an update on Wombi Rose and John Wise from Boston, MA and LovePop, their line of intricate, 3D pop-up greeting cards that Kevin O'Leary invested in during Season Seven.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A woman from Boston, Massachusetts, hopes the Sharks will make a deal and sink their teeth into her chocolate treats that are perfect for women who want to satisfy cravings; a season four entrepreneur from Aeworth, Georgia, returns for a second chance to pitch the Sharks his new business, a line of men’s hair products; a man from Telluride, Colorado, who is desperate for capital, plans to warm the Sharks' hearts with an app that allows users to electronically send handwritten cards; and a man from Boston, Massachusetts, believes he has created a unique way to break bad habits with self-zapping wristbands. Also, recaps and updates featuring the various entrepreneurs that appeared during season seven.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two men from Provo, UT put going to the bathroom at night in a whole new light when their motion-activated LED light is attached to the toilet bowl; two Madison, WI guys use 21st century technology and the power of crowd sourcing to create an alternative to traditional beer; a self-proclaimed introvert from Orem, UT wants to combat blah-looking clothes with vibrant fashions full of unusual flair; and two animal lovers from Cedarpines Park, CA are willing to paw, scratch and pet their way into a deal with their interactive and innovative pet toys. Also, an update on Ryan "Cowboy" Ehmann from Mead, CO and his Lose 12 Inches workout program that teaches people how to exercise in their heart rate zone, in which Daymond John invested in during Season Four.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two former advertising guys in New York try to sell the Sharks a cure for cell-phone addiction; emotions rise when entrepreneurs from Orlando, Florida talk about the inspiration behind their wireless cuddly toy that tells science and math stories to children; two pet lovers from Austin, Texas design and customize accessories for the most important member of the family: your one-of-a-kind pet; and two men from Huntington Beach, California hope they can lock up an investment deal with their high-tech "smart" tool box. Also, Lori Greiner takes 10 of her entrepreneurs – whose combined sales now total $188 million - to the Orgill Trade Show in Orlando, Florida, on "Shark Tank."

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An immigrant entrepreneur from Honolulu, Hawaii, cuts her own hair in front of the Sharks to demonstrate her products; an award-winning, self-taught baker from Rochester, New York, hopes to sweeten the deal with her healthy ready-to-eat frosting; a kid-preneur sister and brother duo from Jacksonville, Florida, pitch their lucrative interchangeable jewelry business; and three business partners from San Diego, California, are determined to convince the Sharks to hop on board with their wheelless skateboards. Also, an update on Dan Barnes and Wesley Laporte from Orem, Utah, and Phone Soap, their product offering a quick and convenient way to clean your phone that Lori Greiner invested in during season six.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver Antonio Brown stops by the Tank to tout the benefits of personalized shoe slides developed by an entrepreneur from Norwood, Massachusetts; a wise-beyond-her-years 16-year-old high school junior from Naperville, Illinois, impresses the Sharks with an app that can stop cyberbullying messages before the damage can be done; two men from Howell, New Jersey, designed an ingenious at-home beer dispenser that uses sound waves that makes bottled and canned beer taste just like draft; with inspiration from her terminally ill mother, a woman from West Valley City, Utah, realized that sending heartwarming chicken soup was the perfect gift and a needed business. Also, an update on Shaan Patel from Las Vegas, Nevada, and his SAT prep course, 2400 Expert, in which Mark Cuban invested in during season seven.

programme.desc: Ein junger Revolverheld wird angeheuert, um einen alten Minenarbeiter und dessen Tochter vor einem skrupellosen Geschäftsmann zu schützen.

programme.title: Das Maschinengewehr
programme.desc: Zwei Deserteure stehlen ein Gatling‑Geschütz, um einen Apache‑Stamm wegen Gold anzugreifen, verfolgt von Kavallerie und Apachen.

programme.title: Angriff der schwarzen Bande
programme.desc: Der tüchtige Sheriff Caleb Wells wird vom kurzsichtigen Stadtrat gefeuert und macht so einer Gruppe von Ganoven den Weg frei, um die friedliche und wehrlose Stadt zu zerstören.

programme.title: Zwei schaffen alle
programme.desc: Ein exzentrischer Kopfgeldjäger jagt einen berüchtigten Outlaw, was zu einer Reihe komischer Missgeschicke führt.

programme.title: Die Todesschlucht von Arizona
programme.desc: Zwei Viehzüchter reisen nach British Columbia auf der Suche nach Land und Gold, geraten jedoch an einen rücksichtslosen lokalen Boss, der die Region kontrolliert.

programme.title: Der schnellste Colt von River Falls
programme.desc: Gunman Dave, Augenzeuge eines heimtückischen Mordes an einem Richter, kommt der Mörderbande auf die Spur, die eine ganze Stadt terrorisiert

programme.title: Mörder des Klans
programme.desc: Nach einem Raubzug trifft sich die Hogan-Bande auf einer Ranch, um auf die Beute zu warten, die Hogans Freundin Daisy vorbeibringen soll. Plötzlich taucht auch noch ein mysteriöser Fremder namens John Webb auf, der ebenfalls einen Anteil haben möchte. Es kommt zu einer großen Auseinandersetzung bei der es fast keine Überlebenden gibt.

programme.title: Black Robe - Am Fluss der Irokesen
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1634 bricht der junge Jesuitenpater LaForgue auf, um eine katholische Mission tief im unerforschten Herzen Neufrankreichs zu gründen. Begleitet von einem unerfahrenen Assistenten und einer Gruppe Algonkin-Indianer, beginnt eine Reise durch eisige Wildnis, dunkle Wälder und feindliches Stammesgebiet – ein Weg, der bald zur Zerreißprobe für Körper, Geist und Seele wird. Während sein Begleiter sich in die Tochter eines Häuptlings verliebt, wächst das Misstrauen der Ureinwohner gegenüber dem „Schwarzrock“, den sie für einen Dämon halten. Als die Gruppe in einen blutigen Hinterhalt der Irokesen gerät, eskaliert die Lage: Gewalt, Folter und spirituelle Verzweiflung reißen die Reisenden in einen Strudel aus Angst und Glaubenszweifeln. Inmitten von Tod und Dunkelheit muss LaForgue entscheiden, ob seine Mission göttliche Erlösung bringt – oder den Untergang.

programme.title: Rhapsodie in Blei
programme.desc: Der Wilde Westen spielt verrückt, als der größte Schnellziehende, elegant gekleidete, silbersporntragende, Gitarrenspielende und singende Cowboy-Matinee-Star Rex O’Herlihan (Tom Berenger) in den Sattel steigt – in dieser schrägen, liebevollen Persiflage auf die B-Western der 1940er-Jahre. Rex kennt alle Regeln des Genres: Der Viehbaron ist böse, die Schafzüchter sind arm, und irgendwo wartet eine Frau, die ihn anhimmelt. Mit blitzschnellem Colt und einem Lächeln, das selbst Kugeln alt aussehen lässt, reitet er in eine Stadt voller Klischees. Dort trifft er auf den skrupellosen Colonel Ticonderoga, der die Eisenbahn als Waffe benutzt, und auf eine schöne Rancherin, die für Herzklopfen sorgt. Doch die Parodie wird zum Abenteuer, als der Colonel einen singenden Revolverhelden schickt – Bob Barber. Zwischen übertriebenen Duellen, Saloon-Gesängen und selbstironischen Kommentaren liefert Berenger eine Hommage an das Genre, die Humor und Action perfekt mischt. Ein Western, der alle Regeln kennt – und sie genüsslich bricht.

programme.title: Ferner Donner
programme.desc: Der hungernde Cree-Indianer Voice stiehlt eine Kuh, die zum Viehbestand der Regierung gehört. Die Gebirgspolizei nimmt den Dieb sofort gefangen. Der Soldat Dan Candy hat Mitleid mit der Rothaut und löst die Fesseln. Von da an nimmt das Schicksal seinen Lauf, denn Dan Candy muss laut Vorschrift Voice verfolgen und wird auf verhängnisvolle Weise von dem verängstigten Indianer getötet.Jetzt will die Gebirgspolizei diesen Tod rächen und mit Kanonendonner und Schwadronen wird Jagd auf die Rothaut gemacht. Dem ursprünglich eigentlich harmlosen Kuhdiebstal folgt nun ein blutiges Massaker.

programme.title: Der weiße Sohn der Sioux - The Savage
programme.desc: Nach einem blutigen Überfall auf seinen Wagenzug überlebt nur Jim Aherne Jr. (Charlton Heston). Die Sioux nehmen ihn auf, geben ihm den Namen War Bonnet und erziehen ihn zum Krieger. Jahre später droht ein neuer Konflikt: Goldfunde in den Black Hills gefährden den Friedensvertrag. War Bonnet wird als Vermittler zum Fort geschickt, doch Misstrauen und Hass kochen hoch. Zwischen zwei Welten hin- und hergerissen, rettet er Soldaten, verliebt sich in die mutige Tally, und kämpft gegen Intrigen im eigenen Stamm. Als seine Schwester Luta stirbt, eskaliert die Gewalt – War Bonnet führt die Sioux in einen Hinterhalt. Doch im entscheidenden Moment erkennt er, dass Rache beide Seiten zerstört. Mit Mut und Opferbereitschaft versucht er, ein Massaker zu verhindern.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 1 Blutspuren
programme.desc: Eine von Sammy Cook angeführte Bande Weißer hat einen jungen Indianermestizen aus einem Arapaho-Dorf entführt. Zusammen mit Alter Bär und Winnetou verfolgen die Indianer die Weißen. Aus den Ruinen, in denen sie sich versteckt halten, eröffnen die Weißen das Feuer und töten Alter Bär. Schwerverletzt kann Winnetou entkommen.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 2 Ein junger Komantche
programme.desc: Kaum ist Winnetou wieder geheilt, wird er von einem jungen Komantschen angegriffen, der sein Pferd stehlen will. Winnetou nimmt sich des Burschen an und nennt ihn Tashunko Sapa (Eric Do). Er adoptiert seinen jungen Freund und ist zu dem Jungen wie ein Vater.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 3 Der Mann für indianische Angelegenheiten
programme.desc: Aus einem Ausritt hören Winnetou und Tashunko Schüsse aus einer Schlucht. Sie entdecken dort eine zertrümmerte Kutsche und den schwer verletzten Beamten für indianische Angelegenheiten, Vincent. Er wurde von Banditen überfallen …

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 4 Der Zweikampf
programme.desc: Winnetou und Tashunko haben Vincent gesund gepflegt und bringen ihn ins Lager der „Langmesser“. Auf dem Weg dorthin werden sie von Yaqui, dem Anführer der Chiricahua-Apachen überrascht. Es kommt zu einem Kampf zwischen Tashunko und dem Apacachen-Krieger.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 5 Im Fort der Weissen
programme.desc: Das Fort der Weißen ist von einem Indianerdorf umgeben, dessen Bewohner fast alle alkoholsüchtig sind. Winnetou ist verbittert und wütend, als er seine Brüder so sieht. Eine der Quellen des Übels scheint ausgerechnet sein Freund Sam Hawkins zu sein. In einer Fabrik wird der Agaven gewonnene Alkohol hergestellt.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 6 San Hawkens City
programme.desc: Winnetou ist empört über das Verhalten seines Freundes Sam Hawkins. Hat er doch gerade die Auswirkungen des Feindes Alkohol im Fort miterleben müssen. Sam verspricht, eine Lösung zu finden. Als Winnetou und Tashunko weiterreiten wollen, entdecken sie, dass ihre Pferde gestohlen worden sind.

programme.title: Mein Freund Winnetou
programme.sub-title: Mein Freund Winnetou - Staffel 1 Folge 7 Das Feuerross
programme.desc: Winnetou und Tashunko haben zwei Indianerfrauen aus den Händen von Banditen befreit. Sie bringen sie zurück ins Cheyenne-Dorf. Dort lädt der Häuptling Winnetou zu einer Ratssitzung ein. Die Weißen planen nämlich, mitten durch das Gebiet der Cheyennes eine Eisenbahn zu bauen …

Ce soir, une famille a installé son campement dans ces mêmes bois, et ils sont sur le point de découvrir que l'histoire du tueur sans visage n'est pas un simple récit de feu de camp... Peuvent-ils échapper à la puissance d'arrachage violente de leur visage ?

programme.title: Metamorphosis

Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: Ghoul
programme.desc: Lorsque Élise, une jeune femme brillante mais fragile après une rupture difficile, rencontre Richard Roy, un homme charismatique, influent et d’une douceur presque irréelle, elle croit enfin avoir trouvé la stabilité qu’elle cherchait. Mais derrière son charme impeccable, Richard dissimule un tempérament contrôlant, manipulateur et violent. - Dans l’espoir de tourner un documentaire à sensation, trois jeunes cinéastes américains se rendent en Ukraine rurale pour enquêter sur l’histoire d’un cannibale tristement célèbre lié aux grandes famines du passé. Guidés par un médium local, ils s’enfoncent dans une forêt isolée où, selon la légende, rôderait un Ghoul, un esprit affamé condamné à errer entre les vivants et les morts. - Mais dès leur première nuit, l’équipe réalise que quelque chose d’invisible les surveille. - Leur matériel se dérègle, des empreintes apparaissent autou

Bodi atrai a atenção do líder de uma banda de lobos que acredita que Bodi pode ser seu bilhete de volta para a aldeia. Bodi deve encontrar uma maneira de salvar seu povo, sem desistir de seu sonho.

programme.title: Oficina 39: Las Cuentas Negras De Corea Del Norte
programme.desc: ¿Cómo es posible que Corea del Norte, uno de los países más pobres del mundo, financie un programa de armas nucleares tan grande como para desafiar a Estados Unidos? La respuesta: la Oficina 39, una organización legendaria enclavada en lo más profundo del aparato gubernamental. Su objetivo es conseguir divisas por cualquier medio posible para financiar al régimen de Kim Jong-un.

programme.title: Mi lucha: los secretos del libro de Hitler
programme.desc: El documental hace un análisis del infame manifiesto autobiográfico de Adolf Hitler "Mein Kampf", su ideología y lo cerca que su mensaje fue puesto en acción en el contexto de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, y las muchas controversias en torno al libro y a su autor.

programme.title: Las pandillas de Marsella: la guerra de drogas en el sur de Francia
programme.desc: En Marsella, las bandas se disputan ferozmente el control del mercado de la droga, que genera más de treinta millones de euros al mes. Esta actividad de narcotráfico afecta a diversos sectores, como el inmobiliario y los clubes deportivos. La policía, en particular la Oficina Antinarcóticos, trabaja activamente para desmantelar este negocio y ha detenido a 8.000 traficantes en el primer semestre de 2021. Muchos pandilleros están armados, y la violencia ha causado daños a personas inocentes, dejando a familias en el sufrimiento.

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

programme.title: Seré asesinado
programme.desc: En mayo de 2009, el acaudalado abogado Rodrigo Rosenberg fue asesinado mientras paseaba en bicicleta por la Ciudad de Guatemala, un lugar con una alta tasa de homicidios. Antes de morir, se sintió amenazado, creyendo que lo matarían, especialmente tras el asesinato de su amante. Grabó un video acusando al presidente, que casi derrocó al gobierno. Una investigación sobre su caso reveló verdades impactantes.

programme.title: Swat
programme.desc: Es la puerta de entrada de la cocaína a Estados Unidos, donde traficantes y narcotraficantes se disputan el control. El año pasado, 217 personas murieron en asesinatos relacionados con las drogas en Miami. La unidad de élite SWAT se enfrenta a esta ola de delincuencia. Con un arsenal de armas de grado militar a su disposición, también son responsables de combatir robos a mano armada y están en primera línea en caso de ataques terroristas. Los seguimos en acción durante varios meses.

programme.title: El regreso del turismo sexual - hombres alemanes en pattaya
programme.desc: Tan pronto como Tailandia reabrió sus puertas al turismo, los pedófilos regresaron, y el agravamiento de la pobreza amenaza el progreso contra el turismo sexual. Si bien las autoridades afirman que la prostitución infantil en Pattaya ha cesado, los informes indican que los niños maltratados son cada vez más jóvenes y enfrentan mayor violencia. Las investigaciones demuestran que el turismo sexual "normal" pone en peligro a los niños, lo que ilustra la percepción masculina de que pagar por sexo es "ayuda" y las experiencias de las mujeres obligadas a prostituirse. Un turista alemán acusado de abusar de menores logró salir de Tailandia tras pagar un soborno, admitiéndolo, pero afirmando que no pudo recibir un juicio justo.

programme.title: Disparé a mis padres
programme.desc: En 2017 Nathon Brooks, de 14 años, le disparó a sus padres mientras dormían. Este documental sigue a la familia Brooks mientras enfrentan esta tragedia.

programme.title: Evolution of Violence
programme.desc: Guatemala. La guerra terminó hace mucho tiempo. Aunque la gente quiere olvidarlo, la violencia continúa. Cada día, los periodistas informan sobre el próximo asesinato y los trabajadores sociales ayudan a los familiares de los asesinados. La sociedad sufre las consecuencias de los 36 años de guerra civil. Se encuentran fosas comunes en las montañas, ex rebeldes lloran a sus camaradas y un criminal de guerra tiene pesadillas sobre las cosas que ha hecho.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: Los observadores de sectas afirman que las sectas están en aumento. Y hay ciertas características que los expertos dicen que tienen en común. Aunque las organizaciones en este documental pueden o no ser sectas, ex miembros dicen que han utilizado técnicas como el bombardeo de amor, el asesinato de carácter, el miedo y la culpa. Aseguran que fueron manipulados por líderes carismáticos que prometían el único camino verdadero.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: En el interior, los creyentes piensan que por muy mal que sea la vida, escapar sería peor; los expertos en sectas nos dicen que esta creencia es una consecuencia del control mental. Escucha a ex miembros de organizaciones similares a sectas y cómo lograron liberarse a sí mismos y a sus mentes.

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.desc: Ben y Marian Rolf alquilan una antigua y majestuosa mansión en el campo como refugio de verano para ellos, su hijo de doce años Davey y la tía Elizabeth de Ben. No pueden rechazar la oferta de alquiler que les hacen los propietarios de la casa, los hermanos Roz y Arnold Allardyce, a pesar de algunas reservas. La primera de esas reservas es que deben encargarse del mantenimiento de la casa por sí mismos, lo que Ben considera un trabajo demasiado grande, especialmente para Marian y las tareas del hogar. Según Marian, el tamaño de la casa es un desperdicio. La segunda, y quizás más importante, es que la anciana madre de los Allardyce permanecerá en su habitación, y los Rolf deben dejarle una bandeja de comida fuera de su puerta tres veces al día, tarea que Marian promete asumir sola, sin que ningún otro miembro de la familia entre en esa ala aislada para no perturbar la paz de la señora Allardyce. Al llegar a la casa el primer día, encuentran una nota de Roz y Arnold diciendo que tuvieron que irse por una emergencia, dejando solo las llaves necesarias y sin dirección ni número de teléfono donde localizarlos. A medida que avanza el verano, los miembros de la familia empiezan a mostrar comportamientos extraños e inexplicables, y cosas inusuales comienzan a suceder en la casa. El comportamiento más marcado es la obsesión de Marian por renovar la casa hasta convertirla en lo que dice que quiere, o al menos eso da a entender. Estos sucesos amenazan tanto la dinámica familiar como la vida de cada uno de los cuatro. Las respuestas a lo que ocurre pueden estar detrás de la puerta cerrada y a menudo con llave del dormitorio de la señora Allardyce.

programme.title: La renuncia de una madre
programme.desc: Liberada de la cárcel después de 7 años por matar a su marido, una mujer con problemas está decidida a recuperar a la niña que había abandonado cuando era un bebé al cuidado amoroso de la mujer que la ha estado criando, su hermana distanciada.

programme.title: Bajo la superficie
programme.desc: Tras sobrevivir a un ataque de tiburón en el que murieron su padre y su hermana, la vida de Lexy se convierte en una pesadilla. Pero con la ayuda de un terapeuta, profundiza en los inquietantes flashbacks y, poco a poco, descubre la verdad de lo ocurrido aquella fatídica noche.

programme.title: Dos chefs y una tarta nupcial
programme.desc: Sigue a una crítica gastronómica en la cima de su carrera cuando conoce a un chef famoso por rechazar a los críticos gastronómicos en su restaurante. Deberán superar sus diferencias antes de la boda de la hermana de ella.

programme.title: Secretas Intenciones
programme.desc: Una pareja contrata a una niñera para que cuide de sus hijos mientras ellos trabajan. Al principio, todo va perfectamente, pero cuando un incidente inseguro hace que los padres ya no quieran a la niñera cerca, descubren que esta niñera es experta en no ser desahuciada de su convivencia. Tanto, que puede convertir la vida de los padres en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: La Obsesión peligrosa
programme.desc: Cuando el prometido de Megan es asesinado, se muda al otro lado del país y reconstruye su vida con un nuevo novio y una relación más estrecha con su hermana. Cuando se hace amiga de uno de sus antiguos colegas, Lloyd, las cosas empeoran.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, una joven oficial de prisiones lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: La hora de la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando un director ejecutivo vinculado a contratos de defensa es asesinado a las 10:44 p. m., se envía a una agente especial del FBI para cooperar con la policía local. Le asignan a un apuesto detective novato. Cuando otro es asesinado a las 10:44 p. m., la pareja investiga el pasado.

programme.title: Aviones, trenes y Navidad
programme.desc: Durante un viaje de negocios a Indiana, la organizadora de eventos Kayley y el agente deportivo Brett se encuentran con que no pueden volar a casa por Navidad debido a una terrible tormenta de nieve.

programme.title: La verdadera historia de Hamlet, príncipe de Dinamarca
programme.desc: Una antigua leyenda nórdica de venganza, poder y espíritu humano, que posteriormente inspiró a William Shakespeare en su tragedia: Hamlet.
